title: Hinomori Shiho — Lunchtime Chat〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Thanks for waiting.
We should be ready now.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Okay.
From the top.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Honami, count us in.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Right.
One, two, three, four...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Not bad. We sound sharper than usual because of how focused everybody is...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (We're still not reaching the level we did during that show. Like our sound is still missing something...)
bgm_area00001

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Sorry, I need to head off for work soon...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Of course. We can practice on our own from here.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay. Oh, also...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: This can wait until next time, but there's something I'd like to talk about before practice.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: With all of us?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It has to do with what we'll be doing as a band, like how to actually become a pro and stuff.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'd like that too. I tried looking up some information regarding that, but it was hard to say what our best options would be.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That actually goes for me too.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I've also been thinking about what would be best for us or what we need to start focusing on...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So I'd like it if we had a little discussion surrounding that.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, sure♪
Live House

rows.Speaker: Vocalist
rows.Line: Thanks, everyone!
Backstage

rows.Speaker: Vocalist
rows.Line:
That was great, Shiho!
You were a lifesaver back there!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I was just doing my job.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But if you don't mind me asking, what happened to your regular bassist?

rows.Speaker: Vocalist
rows.Line:
Stuck doing overtime!
We might be in a band, but we still have day jobs.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yes, I see... That must keep you very busy.

rows.Speaker: Vocalist
rows.Line: It does. But this also might be the first time we couldn't all make to a show. To be fair, we didn't get to practice together much before this.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Wait, based on how your performance went, I never would've gotten that impression...

rows.Speaker: Vocalist
rows.Line: Really?! That's a load off my mind...

rows.Speaker: Vocalist
rows.Line: We don't always have time to practice, but we also don't want to give our audience a bad performance.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (They didn't actually practice all that much, but still sound great when it counts...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Um, would you mind if I asked you a question?

rows.Speaker: Vocalist
rows.Line: Sure, what is it?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: How is that you guys can play so well on stage even though you haven't had much time to practice?

rows.Speaker: Vocalist
rows.Line: Well... Having known each other forever is one thing. We've been playing since we were still in school so...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, I see...

rows.Speaker: Vocalist
rows.Line: And we decided that since we're doing this, we're gonna play in front of people...

rows.Speaker: Vocalist
rows.Line: So instead of practicing at a studio or something, we usually try to find a park or public space that we can use.

rows.Speaker: Vocalist
rows.Line: It's just so different when you have real people really listening to your stuff, you know?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I know exactly what you mean.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (So we really are just lacking that real-world experience.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (And that doesn't have to be events or shows. It can just be playing in front of people in whatever ways we can think of.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Ichika started to really improve after she started doing street performances too...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Thank you for this opportunity. I really appreciate the advice you've given me.

rows.Speaker: Vocalist
rows.Line: Anytime!

rows.Speaker: Vocalist
rows.Line: Speaking of which, you're in a band with your friends from school, right? We should do a show together sometime!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yes, someday.

rows.Speaker: PlaceInfo
rows.Line: Live House

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (There's the manager. Oh, he's talking to the owner...)

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: Ah, Hinomori. Great work today.

rows.Speaker: Owner
rows.Line:
Thank you as always, Shiho.
You're always a huge help.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm just doing my job, really...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But, um... Would it be alright if I asked the both of you for something...?

rows.Speaker: Owner
rows.Line: For you, anything.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Wait, really? But I haven't said what yet...

rows.Speaker: Owner
rows.Line: You want our permission to let you put on a show here, right?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Y-Yes...
How did you...?

rows.Speaker: Owner
rows.Line: It was written all over your face.

rows.Speaker: Owner
rows.Line: I also heard about that show you did with Iori at that outdoor stage. Congratulations on a successful first show.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: I heard it was really something else. I wish I was there to see it happen.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, uh... Thank you...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But that has nothing to do with what I'm asking now, right...?

rows.Speaker: Owner
rows.Line: I'll let you in on a little secret. I generally try to help those that are chasing after their dreams.

rows.Speaker: Owner
rows.Line: That's why I want you girls to play here to since you've decided to go down the path of trying to become pros.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: Plus, we owe you for the work you've been putting in here and all the times you subbed in on bass.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: Our regulars also like seeing new faces and bands, so they'll be greeting you with open arms!

rows.Speaker: Owner
rows.Line: So we'll try and help however we can, Shiho.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Both of you...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Thank you so much.
We promise not to let you down.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: And please allow me to introduce you to the rest of my band next time.

rows.Speaker: Owner
rows.Line: Of course, I can't wait to meet them.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Thank you!
